live.description: Compact environment switcher and version history
Version and timestamp in header; JSON/CSV import and export
Release timestamps derived from GitHub publication commits
Use one canonical version field to synchronise header, footer and release-time lookup
Promoted complete DEV v1.14.0 application; first LIVE visit on same browser copies DEV people, managers, hierarchy and layout positions into LIVE (prior LIVE data backed up locally)
Keep top-down Classic Org Chart only; retain saved top-down positions and drag behavior

dev.description: Initial release
Compact environment switcher and version history
Classic org chart with hierarchical and functional reporting lines
Top-down and left-to-right classic reporting tree with leader alignment controls
Version and timestamp in header; JSON/CSV import and export
Shared manager connector trunks, functional arcs and interactive relationship highlighting
Release timestamps derived from GitHub publication commits
Manually editable hierarchy levels, with automatic fallback and connectors grouped by reporting level
Use one canonical version field to synchronise header, footer and release-time lookup
Drag and drop cards within hierarchy levels; saved per direction with JSON/CSV layout offsets
Direct card dragging enabled by default, improved pointer capture and free positioning
Dragging any team leader moves all directly and indirectly reporting people in sync, with connected lines updating
Hold Ctrl during drag to move only leader; drag normally to move leader with all hierarchical reports
Autocomplete existing people by name in people-manager and functional-manager fields
Remember selected organization view across refreshes, independently for DEV
Keep top-down Classic Org Chart only; retain saved top-down positions and drag behavior
Seniority timeline view with ascending/descending sorting; editable start and end dates; ended employees greyed out in every view; CSV/JSON columns preserved
Country selector for all people and flag icons on cards across views; retains existing country names
Hotfix: restore absolute positioning to Classic Org Chart cards after country flag styling regression; preserve all team records and offsets
Country input changed from static select to editable datalist combobox, searchable by name or ISO code; country badges preserved
Correct card reuse across Classic, grouped and Seniority views; reset inline coordinates and stale drag event handlers without modifying saved data
Classic Org Chart appears first and is the first-visit default; export the complete chart with connectors as PNG, JPEG or SVG using generic org-chart filename
Hide seniority and employment dates on Classic Org Chart cards and image exports; retain dates in records and other views
Automatically update every people-manager and functional-manager name reference when a person is renamed; block ambiguous duplicate names
Manage type names and colours from a shared legend. Add/remove types, assign in person editor, preserve type palette in JSON export/import; no changes to people or positions.
Classic Org Chart zoom only (25–250%) with +/- controls and slider, browser-persisted zoom, full-size image export and zoom-adjusted dragging
Drag empty Classic Org Chart background to pan viewport horizontally and vertically without changing card positions; retain separate card drag and Ctrl-drag interactions
Fix two-dimensional panning by giving Classic Org Chart its own height-constrained scroll viewport; drag empty space diagonally, horizontally or vertically
